method: Actual source TOWER_SPOTS/pick distances, minRange and CollisionWorld raycast to one walker centre; tar/brazier use their own true eligibility rules. Not a wave simulation.
assumptions: One stationary walker at each point, no headshot movement
All8slots hypothetically filled with the compared type; not a free paid build
Does not model cooldown, projectile miss, crowded per-target rays or dynamic canopy/rope
Brazier/cauldron eligibility has no line-of-sight because current source does not raycast those types
